geometry_method: Manually authored low-poly approximation of the reference image, generated into a saved scene with Unity APIs
dimension_source: Provisional author estimates; not calibrated or recovered from the relative-depth baseline
coordinate_system: Unity x right, y up, z forward; simulation origin is authored
identity_scope: Stable authored simulation IDs; not persistent identities of physical objects
embodiment: One kinematic right arm with a simplified hand or robot appearance; three-dimensional endpoint velocity and binary grasp
headset_input: Cardboard phone head orientation; no phone-based hand tracking or positional head tracking
future_pc_vr: Another XR provider can be added without replacing the task and intent interface
